usedFor: New media in the Brix library is copied to a Dropbox folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Media” in Brix, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Only “New Media” brings a file along, so it gives the action something to save.

watchOut: Check that the Brix file is reachable by public web link, since “Upload File to Dropbox” needs one.
